title: ADformer: A Multi-Granularity Spatial-Temporal Transformer for EEG-Based Alzheimer Detection
abstract: arXiv:2409.00032v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Electroencephalography has emerged as a cost-effective, efficient tool to help neurologists detect Alzheimer's Disease. However, most existing approaches rely heavily on manual feature engineering or data transformation. While these techniques may help with small-scale datasets, they often cause information loss and distortion when applied to large-scale data, ultimately limiting model performance. Moreover, the limited subject scale and demographic diversity of datasets used in prior studies hinder comprehensive evaluation of model robustness and generalizability, thus restricting their applicability in real-world clinical settings. To address these challenges, we propose ADformer, a novel multi-granularity spatial-temporal transformer that captures both temporal and spatial features from raw EEG signals, enabling effective end-to-end representation learning. translated_title: ADformer：一种用于基于脑电图检测阿尔茨海默病的多粒度时空Transformer
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）已成为一种经济高效的工具，可帮助神经科医生检测阿尔茨海默病。然而，现有的大多数方法严重依赖人工特征工程或数据变换。虽然这些技术在处理小规模数据集时可能有所帮助，但在应用于大规模数据时，它们往往导致信息丢失和失真，最终限制了模型性能。此外，以往研究所使用的数据集受试者规模有限且人口统计学多样性不足，阻碍了对模型鲁棒性和泛化能力的全面评估，从而限制了其在真实临床环境中的适用性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了ADformer，一种新颖的多粒度时空Transformer，能够从原始脑电信号中捕获时间和空间特征，实现有效的端到端表示学习。我们的模型引入了跨（通道与时间维度的）多粒度嵌入策略……
tldr: 提出ADformer，一种多粒度时空Transformer，可直接从原始脑电信号端到端地学习时间与空间特征表示，有效提升阿尔茨海默病检测的性能与泛化能力。
en_tdlr: We propose ADformer, a novel multi-granularity spatial-temporal transformer that enables end-to-end representation learning from raw EEG signals for effective Alzheimer's Disease detection.
